title: The Zariski dimension bound
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], i.e. quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme] and locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and let $d\geq0$ be an integer such that the topological Krull dimension of the underlying space of $X$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] satisfies $\dim X\leq d$ (this includes $X$ empty). For every abelian sheaf $F$ on [def-sc-zariski-site],

$$
H^q(X_{\rm Zar},F)=0\quad(q>d),
$$

with cohomology as in [def-sc-zariski-cohomology].

proof.text: Forget the scheme structure. By [lem-weil-pbc-noetherian-scheme-closed-subsets-minimal] the underlying topological space of $X$ is Noetherian, and by hypothesis its topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] is at most $d$. The small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site] has exactly the open subsets of this space and jointly surjective open coverings, so an abelian sheaf $F$ on $X_{\rm Zar}$ is an abelian sheaf on the space, and by [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] the topological cohomology $H^q(X,F)$ is the group $H^q(X_{\rm Zar},F)$ of [def-sc-zariski-cohomology]. Therefore [lem-sc-noetherian-topological-cohomology-vanishing] applies to $F$ and gives $H^q(X_{\rm Zar},F)=0$ for every $q>d$.
